name: @pipeworx/mcp-uspto-ptab

tools.name: ptab_search_proceedings
tools.description: Search USPTO PTAB trial proceedings — patent litigation before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (inter partes review / IPR, post-grant review / PGR, covered-business-method / CBM, derivation). Returns trial number, type, status, the challenged patent, petitioner, patent owner, and key dates (petition filing, institution decision, latest decision, termination). Filter by free-text `query`, `patent_number` (the patent being challenged), `party` (petitioner or patent-owner real-party name), `trial_type` (IPR/PGR/CBM/DER), and/or `status`. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across the proceeding record (e.g. a technology term or company name). Combined with the structured filters below via AND.

patent_number.description: Optional. Patent number under challenge, e.g. "11809431" or "US9876543B2". Matches patentOwnerData.patentNumber.

party.description: Optional. Petitioner or patent-owner real-party-in-interest name, e.g. "Apple" or "Zydus Lifesciences". Matches either regularPetitionerData or patentOwnerData real-party name.

trial_type.description: Optional. Trial type code: IPR (inter partes review), PGR (post-grant review), CBM (covered business method), DER (derivation). Matches trialMetaData.trialTypeCode.

status.description: Optional. Trial status category, e.g. "Pending", "Terminated", "Final Written Decision", "Instituted". Matches trialMetaData.trialStatusCategory.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key (same key as the patents pack). Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/apis/getting-started. Falls back to platform key if configured.

tools.name: ptab_search_decisions
tools.description: Search USPTO PTAB decision documents — institution decisions and final written decisions issued in IPR/PGR/CBM trials, plus appeal outcomes. Returns the trial number, decision type, issue date, trial/appeal outcome, the issue types and statutes/rules at play, and the decision document title + download URI. Filter by free-text `query`, `patent_number`, `trial_type`, and a `decided_after`/`decided_before` date range. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across decision records.

patent_number.description: Optional. Challenged patent number, e.g. "12018298". Matches patentOwnerData.patentNumber.

trial_type.description: Optional. Trial type code: IPR, PGR, CBM, DER. Matches trialMetaData.trialTypeCode.

decided_after.description: Optional. Only decisions on/after this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Matches trialMetaData.latestDecisionDate.

decided_before.description: Optional. Only decisions on/before this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Matches trialMetaData.latestDecisionDate.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key (same key as the patents pack). Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/apis/getting-started.

tools.name: ptab_search_documents
tools.description: Search USPTO PTAB filings and documents within trial proceedings — petitions, patent-owner responses, expert declarations, exhibits, motions, and briefs. Pass `proceeding_number` (the trial number, e.g. "IPR2024-00001") to list every document filed in a proceeding, and/or `query` for free-text search. Returns document name/title, type, filing date, filing party, size, and download URI. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

proceeding_number.description: Trial/proceeding number to list documents for, e.g. "IPR2024-00001", "PGR2026-00039". Matches trialNumber.

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across document records (e.g. "declaration", "petition"). Combined with proceeding_number via AND.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key (same key as the patents pack). Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/apis/getting-started.

tools.name: ptab_proceeding_timeline
tools.description: Build a chronological PTAB proceeding timeline from the proceeding record and its public decision documents. Returns institution, final-written-decision, rehearing, settlement, dismissal, and other recorded decision events; absence of an event is not proof that it never occurred.

tools.name: ptab_patent_risk_profile
tools.description: Summarize PTAB proceedings and recorded decision outcomes for one challenged patent. Reports status/outcome counts and recent matters for review routing; it is not a validity opinion, litigation forecast, freedom-to-operate analysis, or claim-level legal conclusion.

patent_number.description: Patent number as indexed by USPTO, e.g. 11809431.

tools.name: ptab_party_exposure
tools.description: Summarize PTAB proceeding exposure for a petitioner or patent owner, including roles, challenged patents, statuses, trial types, and recorded outcomes. Party matching follows USPTO indexed names and may combine similarly named entities; verify identity before relying on totals.

tools.name: ptab_recent_decisions
tools.description: Return and summarize recently issued public PTAB trial decisions, optionally filtered by trial type, patent, or party. Outcome labels describe the document-level USPTO record and require review in proceeding context; they are not claim-by-claim legal conclusions.

trial_type.description: Optional IPR, PGR, CBM, or DER.

tools.name: ptab_search_appeals
tools.description: Search USPTO ex parte Appeals decisions — an applicant's appeal of a patent examiner's rejection to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board. This is a SEPARATE docket from AIA trials (IPR/PGR/CBM/derivation): an appeal number looks like "2024-001234", not "IPR2024-00001". Returns an outcome-count summary first (affirmed / reversed / affirmed-in-part / other), then the matching decision records, each with the applicant/real-party-in-interest, application and patent number, counsel, art unit, appeal filing date, decision type/date, and the decision document link. Filter by `appeal_number`, `application_number` (the rejected application under appeal), free-text `query`, and/or a `decided_after`/`decided_before` date range. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

appeal_number.description: Optional. Ex parte appeal number, e.g. "2024-001234" (with or without an "Appeal" prefix). This is NOT an AIA trial number.

application_number.description: Optional. The patent application number under appeal, e.g. "16123456".

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across appeal decision records (e.g. a technology term or applicant name).

decided_after.description: Optional. Only decisions on/after this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

decided_before.description: Optional. Only decisions on/before this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Number of decision records to return (1-100, default 25). Outcome counts are computed over this same page.

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: one UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key (same key as the patents/uspto-ptab packs). Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/apis/getting-started.

tools.name: ptab_appeal
tools.description: Get one USPTO ex parte Appeal decision by its appeal number (e.g. "2024-001234") — the Board's decision on an applicant's appeal of an examiner rejection. Returns the decision type, issue date, outcome (affirmed / reversed / affirmed-in-part), issues and rules at play, and the decision document title + download link. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

appeal_number.description: Ex parte appeal number, e.g. "2024-001234" (with or without an "Appeal" prefix).

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: the UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

tools.name: ptab_search_interferences
tools.description: Search USPTO patent Interference decisions — pre-AIA priority contests between competing applicants/patentees over who invented first. A SEPARATE docket from AIA trials and ex parte Appeals. Filter by `patent_number` (a patent or application involved in the contest), `party` (junior- or senior-party name, or either party's real party in interest), and/or free-text `query`. Returns the interference number, style ("A v. B"), declaration date, the junior and senior party (each with name, real party in interest, inventor, counsel, application/patent number, grant date), any additional parties, decision type/date and outcome, and the decision document link. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

patent_number.description: Optional. Patent or application number involved in the interference.

party.description: Optional. Junior- or senior-party name in the priority contest.

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across interference decision records.

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: one UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-uspto-ptab forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the uspto-ptab pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
